issue: जग दिग्गज गर्दभ मृग स्वाना: जग ('world') is not one of Śani's seven mounts. The book and Aaj Tak print जग; Drik Panchang हय ('horse', which chaupāī 29 names: हय ते सुख सम्पत्ति उपजावैं); AstroVed गज ('elephant', जग with its letters swapped).
our reading: जग दिग्गज गर्दभ मृग स्वाना (as the book prints it): the mounts are the elephant of the quarters, the donkey, the deer, the dog …
alternatives: हय दिग्गज गर्दभ मृग स्वाना (Drik Panchang); गज दिग्गज गर्दभ मृग स्वाना (AstroVed)

issue: दियो कीट करि कंचन लंका: कीट 'insect' gives a strained image.
our reading: You made golden Laṅkā as worthless as an insect.
alternatives: कीट for किट्ट 'dross, rust of metal' (MW): golden Laṅkā turned to dross.

issue: पारवती को सती कराई: the story is Satī's self-immolation at Dakṣa's sacrifice; the verse calls her Pārvatī.
our reading: You made Pārvatī give up her body as Satī.

issue: शेष देव-लखि विनती लाई: शेष as 'the rest of' or the serpent Śeṣa.
our reading: Seeing this, the rest of the gods made entreaty.
alternatives: Śeṣa and the gods, seeing it, made entreaty.
